A-conditional-items.what: Carrier of the scoring reference depends on the chosen V1 member; conditional items
A-conditional-items.detail: 08 needs the carrier of whichever V1 member is chosen (O1 line/gate, S2 zone, P4 target player); 05 and 11.b are also conditional. No item can guard on another row's value or span rows. Holding it needs support conditioned on another line.

A-conditional-items.what: Example conditional on E1 = 15 and paired across P2 and P5
A-conditional-items.detail: No selector conditions an item on another row's value, and no field pairs values across rows. A selector attribute would hold it. The items are TYPICAL_EXAMPLE and inert, so no verdict changes.

A-conditional-items.what: Conditional existence of the trigger region
A-conditional-items.detail: Held as PREFERRED_DEFAULT on an EXISTS item, so a non-spatial trigger gives ADAPTED, not VIOLATED. A strict RC-6 forces N/A and makes it an unconditional claim; a true conditional item would be STRUCTURAL.
'can be introduced ... when the goal is defending under overload' depends on a session goal. There is no condition field, and relationship rules only decide collisions.

B-alternatives-across-rows.what: One authored alternative, a target line or zone, crosses rows.
B-alternatives-across-rows.detail: The register makes a line an object kind (O2) and a zone a region noun (S3); a set of alternatives sits on one row only. Held on S2/S3 with an off-list noun, the O1 copy ASSUMED. Fix: a list value or an object-to-region link.

B-alternatives-across-rows.what: One advantage from alternatives on different rows
B-alternatives-across-rows.detail: Multiplier and bonus sit on V7-V9, a free restart on V11-V13; RC-29 alternatives work only within one row, and REQUIRED items for the unchosen alternative read UNMET. LOCAL as a new collection like objectiveSets (live cardinality 1); STRUCTURAL if stage E reads it as changing derivation.
'Two-goal or two-target field' means two of one kind. The âˆˆ selector also allows one goal plus one target, and the grammar has no alternative-of-items mechanism.
'from its goalkeeper or from within its own half' mixes T3 and T4 in one alternative; T3 other actor unnamed

C-cross-element-relations.what: No comparison between two elements' fields.
C-cross-element-relations.detail: "Equal outfield counts" relates P2 of two teams; EQUALS needs a value, and relative terms cover positions and teams only. Fix: a requirement kind whose relation is NARROWS, or a relative term for counts.

C-cross-element-relations.what: Count bound read from other rows
C-cross-element-relations.detail: P2(T) > P2(other) - P5 needs a bound read from other elements. A relative count kind (NARROWS, with referent lookup as RC-21 does for positions) would hold it: LOCAL. If a verifier reads it as changing how support is derived, STRUCTURAL.

C-cross-element-relations.what: Equality between the two teams' P2
C-cross-element-relations.detail: 'Equal outfield counts' is a relation between elements, not a value. The relative count kind of NEUTRAL-08.a would hold it.

C-cross-element-relations.what: E1 as a sum over P2, P3 and P5
C-cross-element-relations.detail: 'Neutrals inside the player total' is a sum across rows. The relative count kind of NEUTRAL-08.a would hold it.

Needs the two channels' combined S6 widths to stay under E3: an aggregate across elements and rows. New requirement kind with the existing EXCLUDES relation. An S6 EXCLUSION of 'central' would be a stronger proxy, so it was not used.

C-cross-element-relations.what: Distinct position spans O4 and O5 (S5/S6 for region candidates)
C-cross-element-relations.detail: There is no relative term 'distinct from <element>' and no cross-row requirement. 03.a is written on O4 naming the (along, across) pair. A new relative term that NARROWS would hold it.
'Numerical asymmetry' is a relation across P2 elements. No requirement kind states 'differs' over PER_TEAM.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: J2 cannot reference a performer role
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: target_player's scoring reference is a P4 role, but J2 takes only object or region references. The fix is a new reference type on an existing field.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.ref: L1: T1 selector (items 01-05, 07, 11; T and V11 declarations)
D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: No T1 selector attribute can pick out a transition by its procedure
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: The object authors a goal-kick restart but not its trigger, and T1 selects only by trigger and qualifiers. That leaves 7 of 12 originals unaddressable. The fix is a field plus selector attribute naming the restart (restart=GOAL_KICK, with a VOCABULARY value): LOCAL. The trigger key stays NOT_AUTHORED.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: J1 cannot select an objective by where it sits
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: J1's selector attributes are role and team, so the open question (must the restart end carry a goal objective?) cannot be scoped to that end. The fix is a positional selector attribute: LOCAL. Declaration only.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: A partition that removes direct contest cannot be forbidden.
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: Region selectors (noun, functions) carry no team, and ACCESS consequences are trigger-keyed, so a standing team partition has no home. Fix: a selector attribute or field on S2. The adaptive opportunity space half is outside the boundary.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: Wide channels cannot be selected apart from other channels
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: S2 selects only by noun and functions, and 'wide' is a position. Items use noun=channel with OWN_INVOLVEMENT, which is circular for the items that entail the channels (02.a, 03, 08.d). Needs a new selector attribute (position class or contributing object) on an existing collection.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: One channel per touchline cannot be required
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: touchline-adjacent does not name which touchline and S2 has no side attribute, so 'one on each lateral side' is unheld; COUNT 2 alone allows both channels on one side. Needs a side selector attribute or per-touchline relative terms.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: This object's modifier cannot be addressed
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: V7 selects only by condition.type, so 11.a (WHOLE_GAME) would bind any region-typed modifier from another object, and the V8a type line gets no item. New selector attribute (condition.referents or contributing object).

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: J1 has no set-membership selector attribute
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: The PER_OBJECTIVE_SET unit is defined by what objectives reference through J2; whether the objectives themselves are in their own set's unit is not stated. A 'set' selector attribute on J1 would hold 06.b exactly.

D-selector-attributes-and-references.what: Field rows under objectiveSets and informationRules have no selectorAttributes
D-selector-attributes-and-references.detail: Items use selector * with OWN_INVOLVEMENT to reach only this object's set and rule. With WHOLE_GAME, 16.a would forbid Wide Zone's STANDING rule (WIDEZONE-17). Selector attributes on these rows would remove the dependence.
O1 selects only on kind, so a midline line cannot be told from target lines. V7 selects only on condition.type, so the two event modifiers cannot be addressed apart. Needs a new selector attribute.
'own-half start area for Team A/B': regions have no team attribute (selector attrs are noun and functions only)

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: Episode team designations on static rows
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: P3 [team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM / ATTACKING_TEAM] and J1/J2 [team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM]: a designation is evaluated 'at the trigger or episode it is attached to', and these items attach to none. Two readers may resolve them differently.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: A value fixed only by another row's selector cannot be CLAIMED on its own row.
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: The target's role (J4) and objective-area function (S4) are entailed through J1/S2 selectors (RC-16); J1 has no reference attribute. Stage C flags CLAIMED rows without items, so J4/S4 carry NON_CLAIMED for other elements only.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: A universal FIELD item is reported UNMET when nothing matches.
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: "Every objective set keeps a live member" is vacuously met with no set, but RC-1 reports a REQUIRED item matching nothing as UNMET. Affects forward results only; if read as a change to derivation it is STRUCTURAL. For stage E.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.ref: S2, S3, S4, O1, J1 declarations
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: A non-claim for "every region, object or objective other than the target" cannot be scoped, so it is declared with * or by naming other kinds beside CLAIMED on the target. Fix: a complement operator, akin to a new selector attribute.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: A row whose only item is TYPICAL_EXAMPLE.
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: CLAIMED because an item addresses it, yet the original says GF2 constrains nothing there; RC-7 speaks only of CLAIMED with NOT_AUTHORED. Declared CLAIMED and NON_CLAIMED; no verdict changes (session rows). STRUCTURAL if read as a declaration-mechanism change.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.ref: declarations on J1, V6, V8b, P4, P8-P10
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: No negation operator for 'all elements except'
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: 'Free except the excluded element' and 'roles other than target player' cannot be selected; a broad NON_CLAIMED or UNDECLARED(*) overlaps a narrower declaration instead. A 'â‰ ' operator would hold it; no relation changes.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: Can V5 point at a view fraction?
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: 'in their half' names a per-team half. V5 lists regions, objects and placements, and does not say whether an SV1 fraction qualifies. If it does not, an S2 half region is needed that the object does not author.

E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.what: No row or requirement placeholder for outside items
E-declaration-and-convention-mechanics-p.detail: Â§1 says outside items are not forced onto a row, yet row and requirement are required fields. I used row 'â€”' and requirement EXISTS/EQUALS as inert placeholders (PCG-14..19).
RC-6 forces N/A on EXISTS items, so an existence the source gives only as an example cannot be marked TYPICAL_EXAMPLE. Only SUPPORTING softens it.
Recommending other objects and the GA-001 link are relations between objects, not game requirements. There is no relation to hold them; this may be deliberate.
channels 'NOT restricted, exclusive or entry-prohibited'; entry 'never compulsory': the game has no exclusion rows (spec 5.8 keeps exclusions in contracts)
possession retention 'never scores'; channels 'never an objective'; goal kick 'never scores and never marks the scoring object': no exclusion rows
no bonus on neutral involvement; no differing zone values; retention rewards may not outweigh progression: no exclusion rows

F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.detail: 'Whether opponents retreat' at restarts has no field for opponent placement on transitions. 'Touch limits' have no row for rules on player actions. Each needs a new field or row in an existing area.

F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.what: No row for rules that restrict play actions.
F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.detail: Banned receivers, forced pass order, pass-direction bans, or a rule stopping a team contesting the ball have no home; V4 eligibility attaches only to the primary event. The exclusions cannot be violated on the structure, nor checked against coach text. Fix: a new collection row.

F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.what: No row for a neutral's participation status
F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.detail: 'Active outfield participant for the whole activity' has no row. knowledge-core EM-0007 Participant State: "Owns the current participation status of performers." A new row in the Performers area would hold it.

F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.ref: notAuthored: pressed, protected status, touch limit
F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.what: No row for rules restricting a performer group
F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.detail: A touch limit or protected status for neutrals has no row to be declared on (and is unauthored: KNOWLEDGE). Pressing and tackling are play (OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY). A new Performers row would hold it.

F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.what: No row for rotating who plays as a neutral
F-rules-on-play-actions-and-performer-st.detail: The register has no rounds or periods and no row for changing which players are neutrals, so this non-claim cannot be declared (also unauthored: KNOWLEDGE). A new Performers row would hold it.
'persistent active outfield participants ... (not rotated)', 'never fixed to one team': no row
'No alternating-turn, queued or sequential-attempt structure' (GF2-18): no row; 'retain reciprocal influence' is outside boundary

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.ref: L4: T6 NOT_AUTHORED declaration (notAuthored item on liveness)
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: No field for the resume condition of a STOP_RESUME transition
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: No row holds 'live as soon as the ball is kicked, or only after a further condition'. Only a declaration needs it. The fix is a new field on transitions[]: LOCAL.

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: No exact row for an opponent exclusion distance at a restart
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: Regions are fixed layout. A distance measured from a restart placement is neither a region nor a consequence referent, so it is held only approximately on V11 ACCESS. The fix is a placement field on transitions[]: LOCAL. Declarations only.

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.ref: L7: non-claim 'Where the restart may be played'
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: No row for a rule on where a restart must be played
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: 'To which zone' is a rule with no row. 'To which player, over how many passes, along the ground' concern play (OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY). This is a non-claim only; the fix would be a field on transitions[]: LOCAL.

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: No field for an advantage's persistence or frequency
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: V11 consequences have no end or cap; time windows end by duration, not by a trigger such as a possession change; nothing holds 'once per possession'. New fields on existing collections. Nothing is authored for them either.

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: No field for the triggers that reset a condition
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: Authored: 'Pass count resets when possession is lost or the ball leaves play.' It needs something like conditions[].resetOn. Held as V6 text (PCG-05). This is a new field on an existing collection.
'regain leading to shot' is an ordered sequence, but V8b holds an unordered set. Needs a new field on V7.
one trigger/team pair only; game also states START: 'both neutrals begin as Team A's teammates', and every restart: 'neutrals affiliated to it'
startPlacement is START only; game places the defending line 'at every restart' and gives a between-description, not a region reference
'No opponent retreat or exclusion distance ... imposed': no row for a retreat distance

G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.what: inactive-zone entry as out of play
G-transition-and-trigger-keyed-fields.detail: 'includes the ball entering an INACTIVE candidate zone ... simply out of play': no row equates REGION_ENTRY of a state-dependent zone with OUT_END_LINE

H1-layout-rows.what: No row for area shape or number of areas.
H1-layout-rows.detail: The envelope is E2 length x E3 width, so one rectangle holds by construction but can be neither stated nor checked, and no other layout can be represented. Fix: a new row inside an existing area.

H1-layout-rows.what: No orientation row for a region or object.
H1-layout-rows.detail: "Lies across the direction of progression" is implicit in S5/S6 intervals, and ORIENTED is typed only for DV1 (SD-07). Placed on S6 as the nearest fit. Fix: a field on an existing collection.

H1-layout-rows.what: Non-claims about period structure and changing ends have no row.
H1-layout-rows.detail: The original says GF2 authors no period structure and leaves whether teams change ends free; nothing in the register varies direction over time. Declared on the nearest rows; nothing is lost because GF2 claims nothing there.

H1-layout-rows.what: No field for a region's orientation
H1-layout-rows.detail: ORIENTED exists but no region field takes an orientation; 'parallel to the axis' is no longer implied once WIDEZONE-07's full length is adapted. New field on an existing collection (regions[].orientation).

H1-layout-rows.what: No envelope row for area shape
H1-layout-rows.detail: The non-claim on area shape has no row: EM-0001 owns Shape (EMD-0003, em-schema.v2.0-rc1.json) but the register holds only length and width. New row in an existing area.
'shared occupancy, no partition or separating boundary': no row holds occupancy or partition
own halves 'need not be marked', corridor 'unmarked', zones 'marked', defending line 'not marked': no row holds marking
zone owner (Team A/B) and ball owner stated; no owner row (zone owner duplicates J3)
direction entry 'Neutrals (2)': no direction of their own, inherit, never defend; DV1 is per team only

H2-value-and-objective-fields.what: No predicate on a value-modifier condition
H2-value-and-objective-fields.detail: V8a/V8b hold only type and referents; 'starts in' versus 'moves through' cannot be held for a multiplier or bonus. New field on an existing collection (a condition value, as V6 is for primary-event conditions).

H2-value-and-objective-fields.what: No row states an in-play change to an object's presence or position
H2-value-and-objective-fields.detail: Objects are static. V13 has no removal, closure or relocation effect, V12 no liveness trigger, V14 no object referent. The liveness clause is unplaced, and it is vacuous for any game on the register.

Whose passes count (ATTACKING_TEAM, the team that then scores) has no home, because V5 takes only regions, objects and placements. Carried in V6 text and PER_TEAM scope. This is a new field on an existing collection.

H2-value-and-objective-fields.what: No row for how information is conveyed
H2-value-and-objective-fields.detail: Authored alternatives, unordered: 'count out loud or use a counter'. The register carries only D006, D007, D008, D011 and D013, with no medium or access-mode row. This is a new row inside an existing area.
're-assignable during play, must change at least once', 'not determinable before that trigger fires', assignments 'independent': no row
'Beneficiary: the team performing the action - never ... a neutral' (field removed in spec 5.8); 'starts inside, or moves through' has no qualifier field
